babblebrush v1.0.0

- Initial release of babbleBrush, a voice-first image editor supporting both UI and API-driven image generation and editing.
- Features include canvas versioning, history tracking, manual editing, version branching, and time travel.
- Multiple AI models and providers supported; users can add their own API keys for direct provider billing.
- Supports image uploads for editing, using references, or mixing images.
- Free trial credits offered; one-time payment required for ongoing access and BYOK (bring your own key).
- API documentation and authentication details provided for programmatic access.
